critical.error: Recommends a MentraOS miniapp as shippable to the public now
critical.quote: Hedge worth considering: MentraOS is an open-source layer that supports several glasses on iOS and Android. If you build on it, you aren't locked to one pair, but you take on a dependency and a second app store.
critical.why: Offered as a hedge for this month's public release through a store; docs.mentraglass.com distribution page: 'There is currently no way to distribute a miniapp built with the Miniapp SDK'; the Miniapp Store does not support it in MentraOS 3.0.

other_errors.quote: Rokid, Vuzix Z100, Brilliant Labs, Halliday: Each has a smaller or less reliable path. Typically that's an Android-leaning SDK, limited iOS support, a small user base, or an immature app ecosystem.
other_errors.why: Vuzix Z100 has a full iOS UltraliteSDK (iOS 14+) and ships as an ordinary App Store app.
